title: How Car Brakes Work in 60 Seconds 🚗🛑 #shorts
description:
Your brakes don't destroy speed, they turn it into heat. Pressing the pedal pushes brake fluid to the calipers, pistons squeeze pads against a spinning rotor, and friction turns motion into heat that vented discs pump away. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#carbrakes #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Secret
steps.text: Stopping a moving car takes huge energy. Your brakes don't destroy that speed. They turn it into *heat*.

steps.label: The Pedal
steps.text: When you press the pedal, a rod pushes a piston inside the *master cylinder*.

steps.label: Hydraulics
steps.text: *Brake fluid* can't be squeezed, so it carries that push through thin metal lines to every wheel.

steps.label: Caliper
steps.text: At the wheel, the fluid pushes a piston inside the *caliper*.

steps.label: Friction
steps.text: The piston squeezes *brake pads* against the spinning rotor.

steps.label: Heat
steps.text: Friction turns motion into *heat*. Vented rotors pump air through to cool down.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Motion becomes *heat*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
